correctness.rationale: For every n>=2, d>=1, r>=1 and connected vertex- and edge-transitive simple H, strict convexity of the fixed-kernel inverse trace excludes asymmetric minimizers after group averaging. The exact 2-by-2 Laplacian blocks and n(r-1) pendant-difference eigenvectors yield K=A/b+(r+1)C_H/a (zero-target convention). Saturating da+rb=1 and minimizing R/u+S/(1-u) gives a unique interior global optimum. All boundary, holding, positivity, and normalization conditions appear in RESULT.md. A freshly executed standalone checker independently reconstructed full rational matrices and passed 775 assertions, including every new critical formula; finite tests are explicitly not used as a universal proof.

value.rationale: A complete natural graph-design classification: arbitrary positive leaf multiplicity and arbitrary connected vertex-/edge-transitive core, with independent edge-by-edge transition choices. The optimum is given by one spectral invariant C_H and a closed square-root law. Contrasting growing-cycle and growing-clique cores expose different allocation regimes (pendant probability ~n^-1/2 versus positive limit), and maximum-degree heuristic ratios that approach (r+2)/2 or diverge linearly in n. This sharp structural and asymptotic separation is substantively motivated by Kemeny-optimal network navigation rather than an isolated numerical coincidence.
